SCE.S:56A120: Opened this shop at 24; wed Masako at 33. Their two kids and grandkids live in the next town.
SCE.S:57E858: When you get outside, press the {8}Select button{2}. A map will appear, and I've marked your destination in red. ...Oh, and my husband is in the back. Why not ask him all sorts of things?
SCE.S:57E960: Your newspaper office? What are you talking about? It's right across from us!
SCE.S:57EA1C: Take the {7}subway{2} in front of the {7}hotel{2}, from the No. 4 platform toward Cathedral. It's really quick. You'll come out at the corner of the church square.
SCE.S:57EB08: Inside the {7}Central Station Building{2} is the station for the private Mine Line. Two stops and you're at {7}Coal Mine{2}. From there you can only go north, on foot or by car. The line used to run right into the mine, you know.
SCE.S:57EC40: At {7}Grand Station{2}, take bus {7}Route C102{2} and get off at {7}Market Place{2}. The station building is behind the bus stop.
SCE.S:57ED3C: At {7}Grand Station{2} there are three bus stops out front. Take {7}Route C102{2} and get off at {7}Wood Lawn{2}. You'll see your friend's house.
SCE.S:57EE48: From {8}Central Station{2} on the subway, right in front of the {8}hotel{2}, take the No. 2 platform. It's one stop. The subway station is inside the {7}Grand Station{2} building.
SCE.S:57EF4C: Change from subway to bus and head for the {7}Central Station Building{2}. The {7}Mine Line{2} station is inside. Get off at the next stop, {7}New Town{2}, and take the east exit. You'll see a red cross sign right in front of you. Easy to spot.
SCE.S:57F084: It's in the mountains southeast of town. I guess you can only get there by car.
SCE.S:57F140: Take the subway to {7}Grand Station{2}, then bus {7}Route C102{2} from out front. Get off at {7}Power Plant{2} and follow the road west. You'll see the {7}plant gate{2}.
SCE.S:57F260: At {7}Grand Station{2}, take bus {7}Route C102{2} and get off at {7}Harbor{2}. Take the road just to the left, heading south. At the dead end go right, then left right away. At the next dead end, the {7}warehouses{2} are on both sides.
SCE.S:57F3A8: Now, how do you get there... Take bus {7}Route C101{2} and get off at {7}Fifth Avenue{2}, then go north. Turn left at the next crossroads and head west. Go under the overpass; it's the building on the left side of the road, about 100 meters on.
SCE.S:57F4F4: Take bus {7}Route C101{2} and get off at {7}Winterfall{2}. Cross the bridge and turn left at the second intersection. After that it's all the way through the mountains to the end of the road.
SCE.S:57F610: Take bus {7}Route C102{2} and get off at {7}Stone Berry{2}. Face left and walk a little north. There are strange patterns around the T-junction.
SCE.S:57F708: The {7}hotel{2} is close. Leave here, head left across the square and follow the road to the main street. Turn right; the {7}hotel{2} stands on the corner of the next crossroads. The {7}subway station{2} is right in front of it, too.
SCE.S:57F824: Your predecessor often dropped by, too. My wife gave advice on all sorts of things. The newspaper opened its branch office over 40 years ago. At one point there were about six of you, but now it's just you and that boy.
SCE.S:57F974: The present building went up when the {7}mine{2} was thriving. Townspeople chipped in to build a fine Gothic one, really. The little church before it was said to have stood there since long before the pioneers founded the town.
SCE.S:57FACC: This town truly prospered on the {7}mine{2}. "Black diamonds," they called it. Plenty of miners worked there, and the town was well off. But then the {7}mine{2} closed... Oh, so your family left town around then, too. The mansion of Yamasaki, the {7}mine{2}'s owner, is up in the northern mountains, but nobody lives there now.
SCE.S:57FC74: That's the {7}Mine Line{2} {7}station building{2}. It's a department store called Max now, but fewer people ride the {7}Mine Line{2} these days, so the store is closed. When it opened I thought, what a modern building. My wife and I used to shop there often. ...I was young once, too.
SCE.S:57FE00: Your friend? ...What a coincidence. I lived near his father. An elite engineer at the mine, paid well, lived on Beacon Hill. But the son turned out poorly. Nothing but weird experiments... Your friend, wasn't he? Sorry.
SCE.S:57FF6C: I run a map shop, but I haven't traveled in years. The cobbler's children go barefoot, as they say. When I stroll over to {7}Grand Station{2} now and then, I remember a trip to the East Coast when I was young. Who was with me? Not my wife. Anyway, that station is magnificent. Almost too grand for this town. Yamasaki donated it.
SCE.S:580128: New Town was originally built as housing for mine workers. The {7}public hospital{2} opened then, too. It's the biggest {7}hospital{2} in town, but lately I've heard rumors of some strange disease going around.
SCE.S:580250: I don't know much about that kind of thing. Computers... ...It was sudden. A huge building went up in the mountains. Some foreigners are behind it, I hear.
SCE.S:58036C: And this is a {7}mine{2} town! These days they ship in gas by boat to make electricity. The plant's on the western shore. As a kid I used to play around there, catching fish.
SCE.S:58048C: The two {7}warehouses{2} nearest the sea have been there a long time. They carried supplies for the mine workers. I think those {7}warehouses{2} belonged to Yamasaki, too. They're not used now, are they?
SCE.S:5805B4: Shady bunch. Temple of the Universe. It's a group called the Cosmic Temple, and rumor has it they use psychic powers, so everyone calls them the {7}Psychic Association{2}. They started gathering in the empty buildings there about ten years ago. About 40 of them live together, I hear.
SCE.S:580720: We went to the same elementary school. Everyone thinks he's pretty eccentric now, but he's just honest with himself. In his youth he was a doctor at the {7}New Town hospital{2}. But after his wife died he's lived all alone in the northern mountains... Why are you asking about him?
SCE.S:5808C0: {7}Crop circles{2}? That was a prank that caused a stir. Not aliens. It even made the TV news once. Some crazy old man nearby who calls himself a "scientist" made them, apparently. And that old man is supposedly friends with Fujita's son.
SCE.S:580A30: The best {7}hotel{2} in town. It became a grand building when the {7}mine{2} was thriving. It used to be a small two-story inn run by a hardworking couple. The restaurant there is famous. Whenever someone visits from out of town, I always take them there. The lounge at the top is stylish, too.
SCE.S:580BC4: This town really grew up with the {7}mine{2}. Before the {7}mine{2}, there was only a little settlement around where the {7}Cathedral{2} stands now. When the {7}mine{2} closed, it turned into a ghost town.
SCE.S:580D18: The blue car in the square? It's the company car, right? I hear it has car navigation. Set a destination and an arrow appears; drive so the arrow points up as much as you can. When the destination name blinks, get out and look around. Driving aimlessly is fun, too.
SCE.S:580EA0: That's the subway running north to south. Central Station is right by the hotel near here. Check which way you're going and wait on the platform. When the train comes, walk toward the door. When you reach your stop, get off through the door; don't ride past it.
SCE.S:580FE4: It connects three stations: Central Station Building, New Town and Coal Mine. A short double-track line. Wait on the platform and when the train comes, walk toward the door. You can't board from the exit-only platform.
SCE.S:581128: There are three bus routes in all. They all gather at the square in front of Grand Station, so to change routes, go back to the station first. At the bus stop, choose your destination. The bus takes you wherever you want to go.
SCE.S:5813BC: You're the new reporter from the building across the street? ...Oh my, you lived in this town until high school, didn't you? But it's changed a lot. You can't tell where anything is now, can you? We have all kinds of {8}maps{2} here.
SCE.S:5814DC: Getting a feel for the town? ...The {7}mine{2} closed and the population dropped a lot. All those shuttered buildings stand out. Everyone leaves for other towns. ...It's gotten lonely. Now, what kind of {8}map{2} do you want?
SCE.S:581604: My husband and I have run this shop for over 40 years, but... we get fewer customers now. I hear you can find out anything with a computer. But looking at a map is fun, you know. Now, what kind of {8}map{2} do you want?
SCE.S:581738: You look tired. Being a reporter must be hard. If you're ever in trouble, I'll help. What is it today, a {8}map{2}? Then go ahead and choose.
SCE.S:581818: Where are you off to cover today? Then please choose a {8}map{2}.
